messages:
Marta Ruiz: Quick question -- internal transfer offer (EMEA -> US) for Senior SW Eng. Candidate accepted verbally but needs to start US payroll 2025-06-01 to align with project. Current US band max = $210k, comp plan suggests market uplift to $225k for parity. Since this is internal, headcount stays same but total comp exceeds band. Also equity repricing request (frontload 6 months of RSU) and ask to carry benefits without gap.

Nikhil Desai: Internal move helps with headcount. Need comp-band exception because > band max. Also benefits carryover across regions is nonstandard. Please attach comp memo and current offer doc.

Marta Ruiz: Uploaded docs: https://redwood-internal/offers/2370012345 + comp compsheet. Candidate requests $225k total comp (base + target bonus), and 6-month accelerated RSU tranche (one-time). If we can't meet that, they'll stay in EMEA role.

Claire Huang: Comp Committee note: internal transfers typically get a market adjustment but not guaranteed frontloaded equity. >band uplifts require VP People + Comp Committee sign-off. Also need to check local tax implications for RSU acceleration.

Diego Rivera: Finance: we can cover a one-time cash retention instead of accelerating RSUs to simplify tax. Need cost breakdown: recurring delta, one-time cash amount, and GL code.

Marta Ruiz: Proposed options: (A) $210k base + $15k one-time cash retention, no RSU frontload; (B) $225k base and no cash. Candidate prefers B but will accept A as fallback if benefits carryover guaranteed.

Jae Kim: Legal/Immigration: since they're already authorized in EMEA, moving to US payroll requires new employment paperwork and local benefits enrollment. Can't truly "carry" benefits across regions; we can offer pro-rated coverage start date. Also vesting schedule changes need written consent.

Nikhil Desai: Routing to offer-approvals-bot for expedited Comp Committee review, indicate internal transfer and tax sensitivity. Candidate needs answer within 36 hours per manager.

offer-approvals-bot: Request 2370012345 received and routed to: Comp Committee, VP People, Finance, Legal, Payroll. Expedited review requested. ETA: 24-48 hours.

Claire Huang: Quick take: strong business case (project critical, retention risk). Recommend option A (cash retention) to avoid RSU tax complexity and keep within band. If VP People approves uplift to B, require Finance sign-off on run-rate and GL.

Diego Rivera: Finance agrees to fund up to $15k one-time from Retention pool. GL code: RET-6001. Will confirm journal entries after final approval.

Marta Ruiz: Candidate timeline: can start 2025-06-01 if we confirm by 2025-05-29 EOD. Please prioritize.

Jae Kim: Also note: if we accelerate RSUs, payroll must withhold applicable taxes at grant. That could be problematic for relocation/importer of income.

Nikhil Desai: VP People sign-off required for any >band decision. @Claire can you escalate to VP People?

Claire Huang: Escalating now. Pinged VP People and Comp Chair.

payroll-bot: Payroll note: US payroll creation lead time ~5 business days after completed paperwork. Benefits enrollment effective date can be backdated to payroll start if approved by Benefits Ops.

Marta Ruiz: Thanks. I'll hold candidate and ask them to pause other conversations until EOD 5/29. Will update when we have final. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
